Essence Confetti:Adds a new bonus of +3% All Essence Gain per 10 items found after 1000 items, as shown at The Slab in World 5.
Gold Food Beanstalk:Grows a giant beanstalk behind the ninja castle! Drop a stack of 10,000 Gold Food to add it with the beanstalk and permanently gain its bonus!
Jade Coin Magnetism:Adds a new bonus of +5% Jade Coin Gain per 10 items found after 1000 items, as shown at The Slab in World 5.
Science Pen:Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '1.02x Plant Evolution Chance in Gaming (multiplicative)' per Crop!
Shrine Collective Bargaining Agreement:Shrines no longer lose EXP when moved around, so you can finally bring those baddies out of retirement!
Science Marker:Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+8% Jade Coin Gain' per Crop!
MSA Expander II:Adds a new bonus type to the Miniature Soul Apparatus in World 3, specifically Jade Coin Gain!
No Meal Left Behind:Every 24 hours, your lowest level Meal gets +1 Lv. This only works on Meals Lv 2 or higher, and doesn't trigger on days you don't play.
Science Featherpen:Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '1.10x Cooking Speed (multiplicative)' per Crop!
Revenge of the Pickle:Adds a new boss page to the left of World 1 in Deathnote. Each BoneJoePickle in your inventory counts as +1 Boss Deathnote Kill!
The Slab Matrix:Further extends the Laboratory Event Horizon, adding another bonus to connect to! In particular, a boost to all bonuses from the Slab!
Science Environmentally Sourced Pencil:Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+15% Cash from Mobs' per crop found!
MSA Expander III:Adds a new bonus type to the Miniature Soul Apparatus in World 3, specifically All Essence Gain!
Papa Blob's Quality Guarantee:Increases the Max Level of all cooking meals by +10. Better meals, better levels, Papa Blob's.
Science Crayon:Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+7% Shiny Mob Lv Up Rate and Mob Breeding Rate' per Crop!
Supersized Gold Beanstacking:You can now drop a stack of 100,000 Gold Food to supersize it! This will obviously give a bigger bonus, and will even enlargen the food on the stalk!
Charmed, I'm Sure:All your Ninja Twins can now equip two of the same charm at once!
Deal Sweetening:Earn +25% more Magic Beans from the mysterious Legumulyte bean merchant found in the Troll Broodnest map.
The Spirit Matrix:Even further extends the Laboratory Event Horizon, adding another bonus to connect to! In particular, a boost to W6 Skill exp gain!
The Crop Matrix:Yet again even further extends the Laboratory Event Horizon, adding another bonus to connect to! In particular, a boost to Crop Depot!
Gaming to the MAX:All plant types in Gaming have +1 Max Evolution, but this one is 50,000x rarer than normal and will make you wonder if evolution is even real (it is)
Chef Geustloaf's Cutting Edge Philosophy:Increases the Max Level of all cooking meals by +10 again! But oh hoho, you sir are no Chef Geustloaf! Good luck cooking to these LVs!
Sovereign Artifacts:You can now find Sovereign Artifacts from sailing, but only if you've found the Eldritch form first.
New Critter:Unlocks a new critter type to capture! These have their own very special vial in Alchemy.
Brighter Lighthouse Bulb:You can now find 3 additional Artifacts from The Edge island.
Laboratory Bling:Adds 3 new Jewels to unlock at the Jewel Spinner in W4 Town. Or, get one for free every 700 total Lab LV as shown in Rift Skill Mastery.
Science Paintbrush:Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist's Data Sheet! Specifically '+0.1 Base Critter caught in Trapping' per Crop!
Ionized Sigils:Sigils can now be upgraded a 3rd time. Push past lame ol' yellow, and further increasing those sigil boosts!
The Endercaptain:Adds the Endercaptain to Recruitment pool. They're very rare, and have a hidden account-wide +25% Loot Multi and Artifact Find.
Mob Cosplay Craze:Certain monsters in World 6 will now have a rare chance to drop Ninja Hats, but only the ones you've found already from the Ninja Castle!
New Bribes:Mr. Pigibank is up to no good once again, and he's looking to get some funding from his favorite patron... you. Well, your wallet specifically.
True Godly Blessings:All Divinity Gods give 1.05x higher Blessing bonus per God Rank. Whats a Blessing bonus? Select a god, it's the one on the bottom, go look.
Science Highlighter:Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist! Specifically '+1% Drop Rate' per Crop after 100! So having 105 crops would only give +5%
Emperor Season Pass:There is now a 50% chance to get +2 visits to the Emperor every day, and your maximum visits goes up from 6 to 11
Science Fancy Pen:Adds the 'Spelunky' bonus to your scientist, which boosts both POW and Amber gain by 5% per Crop after 200! So having 210 crops only gives +50%
Palette Slot:Unlocks +1 Palette Slot in Gaming! This would be kinda pointless on it's own... so it comes with +100% Palette Luck!
Another Gallery Podium:Pardon my interruption sir, but I must urge you to buy this upgrade... another podium slot for your Gallery would be most becoming indeed!
Coral Conservationism:Boosts daily coral gain at the Coral Reef in World 7 in Shimmerfin Deep Town in the game IdleOn on the Left side of the map by +20%
Science Chalk:Adds a new bonus type to your crop scientist! Specifically '+1% Research EXP' per 10 Crops after 200! So 240 crops would only give +4%
Depth Charge Disposal:All Minehead opponents in Mr. Minehead's Depth Charge game have 1 less Depth Charge to deploy! Less mines means less booms!
Optimal Optometry:Your Optical Monocles give 1.35x more Insight EXP/hr, and your Kaleidoscopes have a 1.06x larger boost to adjacent magnifiers!
Menagerie Maxxing:You get +1 extra mission in the Luminous Menagerie, as well as a small but noble 1.10x hourly Lumi gains multiplier!
